name: Assigned Proxy Role
definition: Party appointed by the rights holder to attend a meeting and vote in its name. The proxy can be the chairman of the meeting or another party selected by the issuer. The proxy can also be a third party selected by the rights holder.|The proxy can be assigned by a specific instruction or pre-assigned by the issuer of the meeting.

ProxyPerson.name: Proxy Person
ProxyPerson.definition: Specifies the person who is the assigned proxy for a meeting.

PreAssignedProxyRole.name: Pre Assigned Proxy Role
PreAssignedProxyRole.definition: Identifies a proxy that has been assigned by the issuer of the meeting.
